overview.description: The MicroSectors FANG+ Index - 3X Inverse Leveraged ETN (FNGD) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the NYSE FANG+ index. The fund provides 300% inverse exposure to the daily price movements of an index of technology and consumer discretionary companies. The note uses derivatives to achieve its -3x exposure. FNGD was launched on Jan 25, 2018 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
